summary: Decision dataclass (allowed, reason, policy_name, exception_grant_reason, gate_facts) + explain_action(), giving a human-readable .explain() sentence and structured evidence for an action-gating call — computed fresh per call, never persisted (full trace/debugger UI is a stretch goal per the plan doc). check_action() is now a thin wrapper over explain_action() returning (allowed, reason); behavior unchanged, all 21 pre-existing policy tests still pass.
